newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ shares close weaker ahead of RBNZ statement.
newsitem.headline: NZ shares close weaker ahead of RBNZ statement.

text.p: New Zealand shares closed weaker on Wednesday on softening in Telecom shares and wariness ahead of the Reserve Bank's economic projections due for release on Thursday.
At the close the NZSE40 capital index was 8.76 points lower at 2,265.50.
"The market drifted lower again today and in the short term is looking to consolidate," said Patrick Lee, a broker with Lawrence Millton Howarth.
"Investors were wary ahead of tomorrow's statement by the Reserve Bank."
Mark Stratford, a broker with First NZ Capital, said the market was down about eight points all day.
"There was weakness in Telecom and the Fletcher stocks on the open and a little bit of strength came back at the close," he said, also noting good volume in Fletcher Forest and Brierley Investments.
Guinness Peat Group rose one cent to 90 cents after reporting an improved annual profit and one for 10 bonus issue in line with market expectations.

Tranz Rail jumped 40 cents to $8.85 in line with the rise in its ADRs in New York overnight, while Tourism Holdings shed 25 cents after reporting a interim profit on Tuesday and warnings of a possible lower dividend.
